summary: Project supported work nudges incrementally instead of classifying them as unsupported work transitions.

replay.detail: No startup replay or history rewrite is required. Healthy projection handles the existing work.nudged event through the supported incremental path; stale-health, malformed-operation and operation-conflict fallback guards remain unchanged.

schema.detail: No table, index, stored format or migration changes.

rules.detail: No claim vocabulary, admission, canonical ordering, checkpoint or retention changes.

compatibility.detail: Updated receivers classify the existing work.nudged kind as supported incremental input. Older receivers can still fall back to canonical replay. Nudge views and the existing receive wake classification are preserved; other work kinds and guards are unchanged.

manual.detail: Normal forward binary upgrade; no migration or operator state conversion.

recovery.detail: Existing stale projection, malformed metadata and conflicted operation recovery remain intact. No retry or fallback is added.

downtime.detail: Ordinary binary restart. Controls are unrun; no measured saving or incident-cure claim.
